headline: Executive order closed most federal government offices on Monday, December 24, 2007, Christmas Eve.
what_it_does: This order closed federal executive departments and agencies for the day on Monday, December 24, 2007. That gave most federal workers Christmas Eve off, creating a longer holiday break before Christmas Day. Orders like this usually let agency heads keep some offices open when needed, but the title alone does not give those details.

who_it_affects.how: Most were excused from work on December 24, 2007.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal offices and services
who_it_affects.how: Many federal offices were closed that day, so in-person services may not have been available.
